Check stroke weights against a journal's minimum line weight

Source: R/checks.R
olinkviz_check_lines.Rd

Walks the drawn plot and finds the thinnest visible stroke (axis lines, ticks, grid lines, error bars, outlines), in points. Strokes thinner than the journal's minimum weight raise a [warning()]; a journal whose guide states no minimum is checked against 0.25 pt.

Usage

olinkviz_check_lines(
  plot,
  journal = getOption("olinkviz.journal", "nature"),
  min_pt = NULL
)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot or patchwork object.

journal

Any registered journal id (see [journal_specs()]).

min_pt

Override the minimum line weight, in points.

Value

A data frame with one row per offending run of strokes (`element`, `lw_pt`, `n`, `limit_pt`), invisibly.

See also

Other checks: olinkviz_check_colour(), olinkviz_check_fit(), olinkviz_check_size(), olinkviz_check_text(), olinkviz_preflight()

Examples

library(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, linewidth = 0.05) +
  theme_journal("cell")
res <- suppressWarnings(olinkviz_check_lines(p, "cell"))
res
#> <lines check, journal 'cell'> 1 issue row(s)
#>      element     lw_pt n limit_pt
#>  data stroke 0.1066978 1      0.5
